channel.title: Pocallum — Photography services in Barcelona
channel.description: Cultural photography. Jazz, blues, theatre, dance and performing arts. Barcelona.

item.title: Actor portfolio photography in Barcelona
item.description:
Your portfolio is your first impression. Casting directors, agencies and producers look at it for a few seconds: either it hooks them or it doesn’t. A white backdrop and studio lighting won’t tell your story. We will.

What does an actor portfolio with Pocallum include?

We work with natural or reportage light — never generic studio setups — to capture your real range. The result is a set of photographs that show character, expressive depth and presence, not a series of poses.

item.title: Album cover photography and design in Barcelona
item.description:
The cover is the first thing they’ll hear with their eyes. You have three seconds to make someone click, pick it off the shelf, read your name. It’s not an illustration of the album: it’s a door. If the door doesn’t open, what’s inside doesn’t matter.

Photography, design or both?

We can handle the photography, the graphic design or the whole package. We’ve worked with our own photographic material, with archive material from the artist and with concepts built from scratch. What we don’t do is put a nice photo in a template.

item.title: Artist portfolio photography for musicians in Barcelona
item.description:
A musician or artist’s image is part of the project — not a supplement. When the photo doesn’t tell the same story as the music, something’s off. We understand this from the inside: years documenting live performances have taught us the difference between a photo of a musician and a photo that sounds like them.

What is an artist portfolio for?

For everything that needs an image that represents you: press kits and dossiers, Spotify and streaming platform profiles, social media, album or sleeve artwork, concert posters, and presentations to promoters and festivals.

item.title: Artistic photobook — concept, editing and printing
item.description:
A photobook is not an album or an image catalogue. It’s an editorial object: it has weight, intention, a sequence that builds meaning. The difference between a folder of JPEGs and a photobook is the difference between having photographs and having a project.

From concept to print

We handle every phase: image selection and editing, sequence design, layout, paper and finish selection, and printing. We don’t subcontract: everything is done here, in collaboration with 112books.eu, specialists in fine art printing.

item.title: Band and artist photography session in Barcelona
item.description:
There are sessions that look like clothing catalogues with musicians as models. That’s not what we do. The image should sound like the music: if the band plays Delta blues and the photos look like a cologne ad, something has gone wrong. We know music from the inside — and it shows in the pictures.

Solo artist or band?

We work with individual artists and groups of any size. For bands, we don’t line people up looking at the camera: we document the real dynamic, the energy, the relationship between members.

item.title: Concert and live music photography in Barcelona
item.description: A concert can’t be repeated. The light shifts every second, the musician moves, the moment ends. Either you’re in the right spot at the right instant or you’re not. We’ve spent more than twenty years learning how to be there — in jazz clubs, outdoor festivals, big stages and small rooms where lighting is the last thing the organiser thought about. Since 2002 we have documented live music in Barcelona and Catalonia: the Festival de Blues de Barcelona, ViJazz Vilafranca, concerts at Jamboree, Palau de la Música and dozens of alternative venues. We know the music from the inside, and it shows.

item.title: Event photography for festivals and cultural venues in Barcelona
item.description:
A festival needs images that work the morning after the show, three months later for the annual report, and five years later for the retrospective. We’re not just documenting a moment: we’re building a visual archive. We know the difference — and we’ve been doing it for over twenty years.

Since 2002 we’ve covered the Festival de Blues de Barcelona, ViJazz Vilafranca, Nou Barris Meets New Orleans, Clot en Blues, Pícnic de Blues, Flamenco de Barrio, Arundo Donax Festival and dozens of cultural spaces and cycles across Catalonia. We know the rhythms of a festival because we’ve lived them from the inside, year after year: we know when the best light hits, when the performer relaxes between songs, when the audience becomes part of the scene.

item.title: Limited collector's editions
item.description:
We cover the event —or work from existing material— and the final result is a photobook: a physical editorial object with weight and intent.

In a fully digital age, where we don’t know for certain which images will last, a memory turned into a tangible photographic product —something you can actually touch— adds real value to the whole production. It becomes a remarkable keepsake, ready to give as a gift or to sell.

item.title: Theatre, dance and performing arts photography in Barcelona
item.description: In the performing arts, the photographer is not the central element: the stage is. Our job is to document what’s happening without becoming the main character — without breaking the performers’ concentration or the audience’s experience. And do it well, at the same time. We have spent years working with theatre companies, contemporary dance groups, new circus productions and visual arts performance in Barcelona and Catalonia: from Ateneu Popular de 9 Barris to alternative spaces in Nou Barris, Barceloneta and Gràcia. We know when to shoot without breaking the spell.

item.title: Visual identity and cover design
item.description:
The visual identity of an artistic project isn’t a logo and a colour palette. It’s the way the project presents itself to the world: the album cover, the concert poster, the social media images, the press kit. Everything has to speak the same language.

A single piece or a full identity?

We can create one specific piece — a poster, an album cover, a visual for the tour — or build a coherent visual identity for a long-running project. We work according to what you need, not a fixed package.
